in_marathi.name: Dharanee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Holder of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharanee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharani refers to the earth or ground. The name Dharanee means 'she who holds the earth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dharana' which means 'to hold'. This name is used to honor the earth and represents stability and grounding energy.
